event_definition: sb_total_deaths_best >= 25 within country's borders during calendar year 2027
roster_rule: All country_id values in 2025 source snapshot with uninterrupted country-year observations for 2021-2025; no imputation
primary_skill: 1 - brier(v2_logistic) / brier(frequency) if baseline Brier > 0; otherwise undefined
cohort_reporting: Report all six models on the exact same resolved cohort; no model selection or recalibration using 2027 labels
missing_outcomes: Unresolved; never assign zero or exclude silently. Report country IDs/count and paired coverage before any score
first_resolution_release_rule: Use the first officially published UCDP OrganizedViolenceCY annual release that includes full 2027 calendar-year state-based totals; pin the exact archive and codebook bytes when first available; later revisions separately, without changing first score
uncertainty: Report paired Brier difference, country-level bootstrap sensitivity, event frequency and sample coverage. One future annual cohort cannot establish generalizability across years
retrospective_selection_disclosure: Primary challenger designated after historical revised-release backtests; the prospective 2027 result is an independent forward evaluation, not evidence that previous exploratory test selection was confirmatory
legal_temporal_trust: A supplied TSA root alone is not independently accredited; source as-of and receipt validation require separate evidence
